plan.title: Donations Summary
plan.subtitle: Overview of donations received this year

panels.title: Total Donations
panels.sql: SELECT SUM("Amount") AS n FROM "donor_transactions" WHERE "Date" BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31'

panels.title: Average Donation by Mode
panels.sql: SELECT "Mode", AVG("Amount") AS avg_amount FROM "donor_transactions" WHERE "Date" BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Monthly Donation Trend
panels.sql: SELECT "Date" AS month, SUM("Amount") AS total FROM "donor_transactions" WHERE "Date" BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top 10 Donors
panels.sql: SELECT "Donor", SUM("Amount") AS total_donation FROM "donor_transactions" WHERE "Date" BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

plan.narrative: This page provides a summary of donations received this year. The total amount donated is {{p1}}. On average, donations per mode were highest for {{p2.x}} with an average of {{p2.y.0}} INR. The monthly trend shows the total donations over time, with the highest amount recorded in {{p3.x}} at {{p3.y.0}} INR. The top 10 donors contributed a combined total of {{p4.total_donation}} INR, with the highest individual contribution from {{p4.Donor}} at {{p4.total_donation}} INR.
